description: Bring a whole list in to sort, privately. Pass `url` for a Google Maps list shared with "Anyone with the link" (Curated reads every place), or `picks` you read yourself from anywhere else: a page, an account, a document or an export (up to 1,000 per call; send more with stage_picks). Nothing is added to a list until commit_import, and nothing is published.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key. Reusing it with identical input replays the first result.

list.description: Optional destination list. Otherwise commit_import can make a new private list.

own_list.description: True (default) when the source is the person's own: their notes become their notes. False for someone else's list or account: words stay credited to them.

author.description: Author or creator as the person gives it (books, articles, posts), e.g. from "Title - Author - why". Stored as the pick's author and never replaced by added details. Keep it out of the note.

entry_key.description: A stable id for this entry in its source (a post's permalink id), so running again brings only new entries.

item_type.description: place, book, movie, music, post, product or another Curated type, when obvious.

note.description: The person's own words, only when the source is theirs.

saved_at.description: When it was posted or saved at the source, ISO 8601.

source_text.description: Someone else's words about it (a caption or review), quoted exactly and short. Kept credited, never the person's note.

sort.description: True when most entries are probably not recommendations (an account's posts, saved posts): everything arrives unsorted for the person to keep or skip. Default false: everything arrives kept.

source_owner.description: Whose list or account it is, when it is not the person's own, e.g. "@tinnedfish". Credits them on the list.

title.description: The source list's own name, e.g. "@tinnedfish's posts" or "Films I rewatch". Required with picks.

url.description: A Google Maps shared-list link (maps.app.goo.gl works). Omit when sending picks.

name: start_import
title: Import a whole list
